questions.stem: What are two reasons the organization migrated to the cloud?
questions.zhStem: 该机构是因为哪两个原因迁移到云的？
options: Lower software license prices and faster laptops for staff
A vendor contract ending and a wish to stop using virtual machines
Aging infrastructure that is costly to modernize, and a state law encouraging cloud use
A need to rewrite every application and remove all on-premises networking
questions.explain: Aging infrastructure plus state legislation are the drivers, because the old servers were costly to modernize and hard to staff, and the law encouraged agencies to use the cloud.
questions.zhExplain: 驱动因素是老旧基础设施加上州立法，因为旧服务器现代化成本高且难以招到和留住人员，而法律鼓励政府机构使用云。

questions.zhStem: 为什么重新托管是合适的？
options: It moves VMs without code changes, so it fits the tight timeline
It rewrites each application as cloud-native microservices during the move
It converts every VM to Azure SQL Managed Instance automatically
It removes the need to test applications after the move
questions.explain: Rehosting fits the deadline, because it moves VMs as they are without code changes, while changing 200 applications one by one could not finish in nine months.
questions.zhExplain: 重新托管符合截止期限，因为它按原样迁移 VM 而不改代码，而逐个修改 200 个应用无法在九个月内完成。

questions.stem: How does rehosting differ from replatforming?
questions.zhStem: 重新托管与平台重构有什么不同？
options: Rehosting rewrites the code; replatforming keeps the VM unchanged
Both approaches require a full rewrite of the application
Replatforming is always faster because it needs less testing
Rehosting keeps the VM unchanged; replatforming makes small changes to use a managed platform
questions.explain: Rehosting keeps the VM as is while replatforming makes small changes to use a managed service, because replatforming adapts the workload to a platform such as Azure SQL Managed Instance without rewriting it.
questions.zhExplain: 重新托管保持 VM 原样，而平台重构做少量修改以使用托管服务，因为平台重构是在不重写的前提下让工作负载适配 Azure SQL Managed Instance 等平台。

questions.stem: What is the connectivity between the environments?
questions.zhStem: 连接两个环境的网络是什么？
options: A site-to-site VPN and Azure Migrate agentless replication to App Service
ExpressRoute with Global Reach for the link and HCX to move VMs and extend networks
Azure Front Door for the link and Azure Backup to copy the VMs
The public internet and manual VHD uploads to Azure Storage
questions.explain: ExpressRoute Global Reach plus HCX is the path, because Global Reach privately links the on-premises circuit to the private cloud and HCX migrates VMs while extending networks so they keep their IPs.
questions.zhExplain: 路径是 ExpressRoute Global Reach 加 HCX，因为 Global Reach 将本地线路与私有云私密连接，HCX 迁移 VM 并扩展网络使其保留 IP。

questions.stem: In Azure VMware Solution, which component turns the hosts' local disks into shared storage?
questions.zhStem: 在 Azure VMware Solution 中，哪个组件把主机的本地磁盘变成共享存储？
options: NSX
vCenter Server
vSAN
VMware HCX
questions.explain: vSAN is the answer, because it pools the hosts' local disks into shared storage, while NSX handles networking, vCenter manages hosts, and HCX moves VMs.
questions.zhExplain: 答案是 vSAN，因为它把主机的本地磁盘汇聚成共享存储，而 NSX 负责网络，vCenter 管理主机，HCX 负责迁移 VM。

questions.stem: What phased migration plan do you propose?
questions.zhStem: 你会提出怎样的分阶段迁移计划？
options: Move all VMs in one cutover, then test them in production
Prepare, run a small pilot wave, move main waves, then stabilize and retire
Migrate the most critical systems first, then run a pilot wave
Retire the datacenter first, then build the private cloud
questions.explain: Prepare, pilot, main waves, then stabilize is the plan, because a small pilot wave proves the tools and runbook before larger waves and critical systems move.
questions.zhExplain: 计划是准备、试点、主批次，再稳定和退役，因为小规模试点批次能先验证工具和操作手册，再迁移更大批次和关键系统。

questions.stem: How would you group dependent workloads?
questions.zhStem: 你会如何把互相依赖的工作负载分组？
options: Spread them across waves so each wave has the same VM count
Move each database first in its own wave, then its web VMs
Move shared AD DS and DNS first, before any application
Put an application and everything it calls in the same wave
questions.explain: Dependent workloads belong in the same wave, because grouping an application with everything it calls avoids leaving a dependency on the other side of the link.
questions.zhExplain: 互相依赖的工作负载应放在同一批次，因为把应用及其调用的所有组件放在一起，可以避免把依赖留在链路的另一侧。

questions.stem: How would you test a migration wave?
questions.zhStem: 你会如何测试一个迁移批次？
options: Shut down production and test directly in the private cloud network
Run a test migration into an isolated network segment in the private cloud
Skip testing and rely on Azure Monitor alerts after cutover
Ask users to test the copies on the production network
questions.explain: A test migration into an isolated segment is right, because it lets the team check the copy without touching production or causing IP conflicts.
questions.zhExplain: 应在隔离网段中做测试迁移，因为这样团队可以检查副本而不影响生产，也不会造成 IP 冲突。

questions.stem: How would you decide whether to proceed or roll back?
questions.zhStem: 你会如何决定继续推进还是回滚？
options: Proceed once the VMs boot; never roll back after cutover
Roll back on any small issue; proceed only if users ask
Proceed if tests and baselines pass; roll back if a critical app fails
Proceed after deleting the on-premises VMs; roll back from backups
questions.explain: Clear pass and fail criteria decide it, because the team proceeds only when tests, sign-offs and the baseline pass, and if a critical app fails and cannot be fixed in time, it rolls back.
questions.zhExplain: 由明确的通过和失败标准来决定，因为团队继续推进的前提是测试、签核和基线都通过，而如果关键应用失败且无法及时修复，就回滚。

questions.stem: How would you draw a high-level diagram showing the migration from an on-premises VMware environment to Azure VMware Solution?
questions.zhStem: 你会如何画一张高层架构图，展示从本地 VMware 环境迁移到 Azure VMware Solution 的过程？
options: On-premises vSphere to an Azure VMware Solution private cloud over ExpressRoute and HCX
On-premises vSphere to Azure App Service over the public internet
On-premises Hyper-V to Azure virtual machines over a site-to-site VPN
Azure VMware Solution to on-premises vSphere over Azure Front Door
questions.explain: Draw on-premises vSphere linked by ExpressRoute and HCX to an Azure VMware Solution private cloud, because the VMs move unchanged from one VMware environment to another.
questions.zhExplain: 画出本地 vSphere 通过 ExpressRoute 和 HCX 连接到 Azure VMware Solution 私有云，因为 VM 原样从一个 VMware 环境迁移到另一个 VMware 环境。

questions.stem: What are the source and destination environments?
questions.zhStem: 源环境和目标环境是什么？
options: Azure virtual machines to on-premises vSphere
On-premises Hyper-V to Azure Stack HCI
AWS EC2 instances to Azure VMware Solution
On-premises VMware vSphere to an Azure VMware Solution private cloud
questions.explain: The source is the on-premises VMware vSphere environment and the destination is an Azure VMware Solution private cloud, because the agency already ran VMware and chose Azure VMware Solution.
questions.zhExplain: 源环境是本地 VMware vSphere 环境，目标环境是 Azure VMware Solution 私有云，因为该机构原本就运行 VMware，并选择了 Azure VMware Solution。

questions.stem: What are the application and database workloads?
questions.zhStem: 应用工作负载和数据库工作负载是什么？
options: Azure Functions and Azure Cosmos DB created during the move
Application VMs and SQL Server VMs that move unchanged
Containers in Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure SQL Database
Power Platform apps and Azure SQL Managed Instance from day one
questions.explain: They are application VMs and database VMs such as SQL Server, because rehosting moves the existing VMs to Azure VMware Solution without changing them.
questions.zhExplain: 它们是应用 VM 和 SQL Server 等数据库 VM，因为重新托管把现有 VM 原样迁移到 Azure VMware Solution，不做修改。

questions.stem: Which components do you assume because they are not described in the article?
questions.zhStem: 哪些组件是你假设的，因为文章里没有描述？
options: Azure VMware Solution as the destination
More than 300 VMs moved in waves
ExpressRoute Global Reach and VMware HCX
The VMware environment the agency already ran
questions.explain: ExpressRoute Global Reach and HCX are assumptions, because the article names Azure VMware Solution, the existing VMware environment and the waves but not how the sites connect.
questions.zhExplain: ExpressRoute Global Reach 和 HCX 是假设，因为文章提到了 Azure VMware Solution、现有 VMware 环境和迁移批次，却没有说明站点如何连接。

questions.stem: How do you distinguish case-study facts from assumptions and proposed recommendations?
questions.zhStem: 你如何把案例事实与假设和提出的建议区分开？
options: Facts are your proposals, assumptions come from the article, recommendations fill gaps
Facts come from the article, assumptions fill its gaps, recommendations are your proposals
Facts and assumptions are the same, recommendations come from the article
Everything in the article is an assumption until it is tested
questions.explain: Label each statement by its source, because facts come from the case study, assumptions fill gaps the article does not cover, and recommendations are your own proposals.
questions.zhExplain: 按来源标注每一条内容，因为事实来自案例，假设填补文章没有涵盖的空白，建议是你自己的提议。
